highlights: Channels are back: see them in the home list, open them as chats, and answer questions and approvals from your phone.
Audio files play in the chat with a waveform and speed control, and Markdown files open in a formatted preview.
Swipe through all the images of a loaded chat, and see multiple images from one reply in a compact grid.
Provider plan limits show as rings in the home header.
Android stability fixes for large images, text fields and app start.
